result.stdout:
PhotoAtomic i18n pre-translation tool

Usage: <assembly-path | project.csproj> [--csv <path>] [--all]
       [--verify] [--lint] [--fix] [--prune]

  --all     THE ONE COMMAND. Prunes what the code no longer says, translates
            the values, then the sentences (in that order: sentences are
            declined against the words already translated), then lints and
            repairs round after round until it stops improving. Ends with the
            list of what a human still has to look at — and moves those rows
            to the END of the CSV, so opening the file lands on the work.

  The single steps, for CI and for looking closer:
  --verify  no translation: checks that every catalog unit has rows for
            every configured language; exit code 3 when coverage is missing.
  --lint    no translation: reads the rows themselves and reports what is
            wrong with them (holes that never arrive, variants that were
            never declined, values with no gender, example words left in);
            exit code 4 when an ERROR is found (warnings only inform).
  --fix     repairs what the lint found: from the table where possible,
            asking the model again only for the rows it got wrong, then
            lints once more and reports the before/after count.
  --prune   no translation: deletes the rows for sentences the code no
            longer says (never values), rewriting the CSV. Pass the catalog
            that covers the whole table, or live rows will look dead.

Configuration (appsettings.json next to the tool, user secrets, env vars):
  Translator:Languages  array of target languages, e.g. ["it-IT", "fr-FR"]
  Translator:Csv        output CSV path (or --csv)
  Translator:Endpoint, Translator:Model, Translator:ApiKey   (fill only)
  Translator:SystemPrompt, Translator:ApplicationContext     (optional)
